text:
Zara Osei: Hi all — Zara joining Product Infra today as a platform engineer. Hello! Quick: my Mac asked for an MDM PIN but I never got the invite. Who do I ping?

Maya (People Ops): welcome Zara!! :tada: tagging IT — @Raj can help with MDM. Also drop your desk/remote preference in the onboarding form if you haven't.

Raj (IT): Hi Zara, sorry about that. I pushed a fresh Okta Device Management invite to zara.osei@redwood.ai. If it doesn't appear check Promotions/Spam. After you accept run `profiles status -type enrollment` to confirm. If stuck tell me your laptop serial.

Zara Osei: thanks Raj — checked spam, nothing yet. Serial is ABC-987654.

Raj (IT): Manual token created and pushed. You should see the invite in a couple minutes.

ops-bot: provisioning: created user zara.osei; added to teams: platform-engineering; channels: #platform,#new-hires; repo access: onboarding.

Zara Osei: enrolled now — MDM shows Compliant. Can't SSH into the dev host: `Permission denied (publickey)`. I uploaded a key but maybe wrong path.

Samir Chen: Welcome! Put your key as `zara.pub` in the onboarding-keys repo under your github handle. If it's there already, @ops-bot can run the sync. I'll also calendar a 30m buddy sync.

devops-bot: SSH key sync started for zara.osei; completed.

Zara Osei: SSH works — thanks. Last Q: where's the first-week checklist and who should I ping for on-call shadowing?

Nia (Product): checklist is at internal docs (Onboarding > First Week). For on-call shadowing ping Samir — he'll take you through runbooks and paging.

Kevin (Security): Welcome! If you want a hardware 2FA device reply to ops-ticket #1172 to request a YubiKey.

Maya (People Ops): also FYI welcome pack shipped (stickers + mug). If you're local to Toronto we have a lunch group — drop a note in #random. Fun fact?: what hobby do you bring?

Zara Osei: Toronto here — I bake sourdough on weekends. :bread: Excited to be here!

Samir Chen: sourdough club noted. see you at the buddy sync. :coffee:
